function.name: document_view
function.description: Converts a PDF or PPTX document to Markdown so you can read and analyze its contents. Use a URL for a document available online, or omit url when the teacher attached a PDF/PPTX file in the current message. Do not invent URLs or file names.

url.description: HTTP(S) URL of the PDF or PPTX document. Use only a URL provided by the teacher or returned by another tool.

file_name.description: Exact name of an attached PDF/PPTX file when more than one supported document is attached.
